python - <<'PY'
import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib as mpl
import seaborn as sns

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

mmr_df = pd.DataFrame(data['maternal_mortality_timeseries']['data'])
exp_df = pd.DataFrame(data['health_expenditure_gdp']['data'])
mid_df = pd.DataFrame(data['midwife_coverage']['data'])

# Merge mortality + expenditure for all country-year points
plot_df = mmr_df.merge(exp_df, on=['country', 'year'], how='inner')

# Use latest skilled birth attendance as bubble size encoding
mid_latest = mid_df[mid_df['period'] == '2018-2021'][['country', 'skilled_birth_attendant_pct']]
plot_df = plot_df.merge(mid_latest, on='country', how='left')

# Compute improvement (2005->2021 decline in MMR) for color grouping
improve = (
    mmr_df[mmr_df['year'].isin([2005, 2021])]
    .pivot(index='country', columns='year', values='mmr')
    .reset_index()
)
improve['decline'] = improve[2005] - improve[2021]

# Top improvers = top 3 largest declines
top_countries = set(improve.nlargest(3, 'decline')['country'])
plot_df['group'] = plot_df['country'].apply(lambda c: 'Top improvers' if c in top_countries else 'Other countries')

# Editorial style
sns.set_theme(style='whitegrid')
mpl.rcParams['font.family'] = 'DejaVu Serif'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13.5, 8.5), dpi=180)

palette = {'Top improvers': '#1f4e79', 'Other countries': '#9aa0a6'}

# Draw scatter with bubble sizes
for grp, sub in plot_df.groupby('group'):
    sizes = (sub['skilled_birth_attendant_pct'] - 5) * 9  # scale to readable area
    ax.scatter(
        sub['health_exp_pct_gdp'],
        sub['mmr'],
        s=sizes,
        c=palette[grp],
        alpha=0.78 if grp == 'Top improvers' else 0.58,
        edgecolors='white',
        linewidths=0.7,
        label=grp,
        zorder=3 if grp == 'Top improvers' else 2
    )

# Connect each country trajectory over time
for country, sub in plot_df.sort_values('year').groupby('country'):
    grp = 'Top improvers' if country in top_countries else 'Other countries'
    ax.plot(
        sub['health_exp_pct_gdp'],
        sub['mmr'],
        color=palette[grp],
        linewidth=1.4 if grp == 'Top improvers' else 0.9,
        alpha=0.75 if grp == 'Top improvers' else 0.45,
        zorder=1
    )

# Annotate latest year points with country labels
latest = plot_df[plot_df['year'] == 2021]
for _, row in latest.iterrows():
    dx = 0.05
    dy = 7 if row['country'] in top_countries else 0
    ax.text(
        row['health_exp_pct_gdp'] + dx,
        row['mmr'] + dy,
        row['country'],
        fontsize=9,
        color='#243447',
        alpha=0.95,
        va='center'
    )

# Axes and title
ax.set_title(
    'Health Spending, Skilled Birth Attendance, and Maternal Mortality\n'
    'Eight-country trajectories (2005–2021) with top MMR improvers highlighted',
    fontsize=16,
    pad=16,
    weight='semibold'
)
ax.set_xlabel('Health expenditure (% of GDP)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Maternal mortality ratio (deaths per 100,000 live births)', fontsize=12)

# Invert y-axis so improvement (lower mortality) trends upward visually
ax.invert_yaxis()

# Bubble size legend for coverage
for size_val in [40, 60, 80, 95]:
    ax.scatter([], [], s=(size_val - 5) * 9, c='#6b7280', alpha=0.45, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.7,
               label=f'Skilled birth attendance: {size_val}%')

# Build combined legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
# Keep first occurrence of each label
seen = set()
uniq_h, uniq_l = [], []
for h, l in zip(handles, labels):
    if l not in seen:
        uniq_h.append(h)
        uniq_l.append(l)
        seen.add(l)

leg = ax.legend(uniq_h, uniq_l, title='Country group and bubble size',
                loc='upper right', frameon=True, framealpha=0.95, fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
leg.get_frame().set_edgecolor('#d1d5db')

# Grid and limits
ax.grid(True, axis='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.4)
ax.set_xlim(plot_df['health_exp_pct_gdp'].min() - 0.2, plot_df['health_exp_pct_gdp'].max() + 0.5)
ax.set_ylim(plot_df['mmr'].max() + 45, max(0, plot_df['mmr'].min() - 30))

# Source note
fig.text(
    0.01, 0.01,
    'Data: maternal_mortality_timeseries, health_expenditure_gdp, midwife_coverage (2018–2021).\n'
    'Top improvers based on absolute MMR decline from 2005 to 2021.',
    ha='left', va='bottom', fontsize=8, color='#4b5563'
)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.05, 1, 1])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)

print('Saved /app/output/result.png')
PY

python - <<'PY'
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib as mpl
from collections import defaultdict

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

mmr = data['maternal_mortality_timeseries']['data']
exp = data['health_expenditure_gdp']['data']
mid = data['midwife_coverage']['data']

# Index helpers
exp_idx = {(d['country'], d['year']): d['health_exp_pct_gdp'] for d in exp}
mid_latest = {d['country']: d['skilled_birth_attendant_pct'] for d in mid if d['period'] == '2018-2021'}

# Build plot points
points = []
country_series = defaultdict(list)
for d in mmr:
    c, y, m = d['country'], d['year'], d['mmr']
    x = exp_idx[(c, y)]
    cov = mid_latest[c]
    rec = {'country': c, 'year': y, 'mmr': m, 'exp': x, 'cov': cov}
    points.append(rec)
    country_series[c].append(rec)

# Top improvers by 2005->2021 decline
mmr_by_country_year = defaultdict(dict)
for d in mmr:
    mmr_by_country_year[d['country']][d['year']] = d['mmr']

declines = []
for c, ys in mmr_by_country_year.items():
    declines.append((c, ys[2005] - ys[2021]))

declines.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
top = set([c for c, _ in declines[:3]])

# Style
mpl.rcParams['font.family'] = 'DejaVu Serif'
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13.5, 8.5), dpi=180)

palette = {'Top improvers': '#1f4e79', 'Other countries': '#9aa0a6'}

# Draw trajectories first
for c, series in country_series.items():
    series = sorted(series, key=lambda r: r['year'])
    grp = 'Top improvers' if c in top else 'Other countries'
    ax.plot([r['exp'] for r in series], [r['mmr'] for r in series],
            color=palette[grp], linewidth=1.4 if grp=='Top improvers' else 0.9,
            alpha=0.75 if grp=='Top improvers' else 0.45, zorder=1)

# Scatter by group
for grp in ['Top improvers', 'Other countries']:
    sub = [r for r in points if ('Top improvers' if r['country'] in top else 'Other countries') == grp]
    ax.scatter(
        [r['exp'] for r in sub],
        [r['mmr'] for r in sub],
        s=[(r['cov'] - 5) * 9 for r in sub],
        c=palette[grp],
        alpha=0.78 if grp == 'Top improvers' else 0.58,
        edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.7,
        label=grp,
        zorder=3 if grp == 'Top improvers' else 2
    )

# Annotate 2021 endpoints
for c, series in country_series.items():
    end = sorted(series, key=lambda r: r['year'])[-1]
    ax.text(end['exp'] + 0.05, end['mmr'] + (7 if c in top else 0), c,
            fontsize=9, color='#243447', va='center')

ax.set_title(
    'Health Spending, Skilled Birth Attendance, and Maternal Mortality\n'
    'Eight-country trajectories (2005–2021) with top MMR improvers highlighted',
    fontsize=16, pad=16, weight='semibold'
)
ax.set_xlabel('Health expenditure (% of GDP)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Maternal mortality ratio (deaths per 100,000 live births)', fontsize=12)

# Invert y-axis so lower mortality appears higher (improvement)
ax.invert_yaxis()

# Bubble size legend
for size_val in [40, 60, 80, 95]:
    ax.scatter([], [], s=(size_val - 5) * 9, c='#6b7280', alpha=0.45,
               edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.7,
               label=f'Skilled birth attendance: {size_val}%')

handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
seen, uh, ul = set(), [], []
for h, l in zip(handles, labels):
    if l not in seen:
        uh.append(h); ul.append(l); seen.add(l)

leg = ax.legend(uh, ul, title='Country group and bubble size', loc='upper right',
                frameon=True, framealpha=0.95, fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
leg.get_frame().set_edgecolor('#d1d5db')

all_exp = [r['exp'] for r in points]
all_mmr = [r['mmr'] for r in points]
ax.set_xlim(min(all_exp)-0.2, max(all_exp)+0.5)
ax.set_ylim(max(all_mmr)+45, max(0, min(all_mmr)-30))
ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.4)

fig.text(0.01, 0.01,
         'Data: maternal_mortality_timeseries, health_expenditure_gdp, midwife_coverage (2018–2021).\n'
         'Top improvers based on absolute MMR decline from 2005 to 2021.',
         ha='left', va='bottom', fontsize=8, color='#4b5563')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.05, 1, 1])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
print('Saved /app/output/result.png')
